description: Point one of a flow's connection references at a real connection, which is the step that lets a flow be switched on. Picks the reference and the connection for you when there is only one of each, and asks when there is a choice. Handles both shapes: a flow that names a connection directly is edited in place, while a flow that came from a solution has its connectionreference row bound instead. Pass activate: true to turn the flow on in the same call once it is bound. Changes a live environment: requires confirm: true.

activate.description: Turn the flow on after binding; default false

clientId.description: Entra app (client) id for MSAL. Defaults to CPS_CLIENT_ID, then the first-party VS Code id.

confirm.description: Required to actually perform a change in a live environment. Without it the tool returns a dry run.

connectionId.description: The connection to bind (its name from cs_list_connections); default: the only usable one for this connector

connector.description: Connector id, e.g. shared_office365, to choose the reference by connector instead

dataverseUrl.description: Dataverse URL; default: from the workspace or the environment

environmentId.description: Power Platform environment id (GUID). Defaults to workspace sync metadata or CPS_ENVIRONMENT_ID.

reference.description: Which connection reference to bind; only needed when the flow has more than one

search.description: Narrow the candidate connections by display name or owner

tenantId.description: Entra tenant id. Defaults to the workspace sync metadata, then CPS_TENANT_ID.

workspace.description: Path to (or inside) the agent workspace. Defaults to CPS_WORKSPACE or the current directory.

name: cs_bind_flow_connection
title: Bind a flow's connection
